_provenance.notes: Alaska exports ~75% of its commercial seafood production by value. Trade flows have evolved through three distinct eras: (1) Japan Dominance (1970-1995), where high-value salmon roe, sockeye, and sablefish went directly to Tokyo; (2) China Re-Export Processing Shift (2000-2017), where head-and-gut salmon and pollock were shipped to Qingdao for hand-filleting and re-exported globally; (3) Tariff & Geopolitical Realignment (2018-2024), where US-China tariffs (25%) and Russian seafood import bans altered global whitefish and salmon supply chains.
